paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: copy a whole chat message - text, images, videos and files - and paste
it back into any session's composer with the media still attached.
# dsh-seesion-copy-enhance
Copy a **whole** chat message in DeepSeek Harness - text, images, videos and files - and paste it ba
ck into **any** session with the attachments still there.
DSH's built-in copy button writes `text` only, so a message with screenshots or files arrives elsewh
ere as bare text. This plugin takes over that button, puts the complete message on the clipboard, an
d rebuilds the attachments as real composer drafts when you paste - ready to send.
- Package: `dsh-seesion-copy-enhance` (spelling follows the original request, `seesion`; use it verb

atim when installing)
- Version: `0.2.0`
- License: MIT, source on GitHub
## What it does
| Action | Stock DSH | With this plugin |

| Copy a message with images | text only | text + every image |
| Copy a message with files/videos |

text only | text + every attachment |
| Paste into another session | plain text | text + attachment

cards, ready to send |
| Paste into the same session | plain text | text + attachment cards |
| Pas

te into a rich-text app (Word, Notion, mail) | plain text | text + inline images |
| Paste after a p
age reload | plain text | text + attachments (restored through the Host bridge) |
The clipboard carries two flavours: `text/plain` (clean text - pasting into a terminal still works)

and `text/html` (a hidden media token plus inline `data:` images). On paste the client reads the
tok

en, asks the Host for the full bundle, turns every entry back into a real `File`, and hands it to
th
e session's draft-attachment channel - the same path drag-and-drop uploads use. The attachments are
genuine drafts: they upload and send normally. Nothing is a fake card.
## Supported versions
| DSH version | Status | Notes |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` | ✅ Verified | End-to-end on this machine: capture / resolve / clipboard write / draf

t restore |
| `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` | ✅ Declared | `engines.dsh` in `package.json`; the market and the in

staller check it |
| other `0.2.x` rc builds | ⚠️ Expected | Uses public 0.2 slots and services, not

verified per rc |
| `0.1.x` | ❌ Unsupported | No `conversation.composer.dock` slot and no `createDr

afts` draft channel |
| `>=0.3.0` | ❌ Not declared | Re-verify before widening the range |
The plugin also self-checks at runtime: `GET /dsh-seesion-copy-enhance/health` reports `version` and
`capabilities` (whether `readImage` / `readFileStream` / `imageHostPath` / `fileHostPath` exist). I

f a
capability is missing, the plugin does **not** throw - it degrades to a text-only copy, says so

in the
toast, and leaves the stock copy/paste behaviour untouched.
## Install
### 1. Plugin market (recommended)
Open **Plugins → Discover** in DSH, search for `dsh-seesion-copy-enhance`, install, then restart or
refresh as prompted.
### 2. Command line
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use your real profile name (`desktop` on the desktop app, often `web` on a web install).
### 3. In-app plugin manager (local package)
Pack first, then install the `.tgz`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Installing from a `file:` **directory** only works on ordinary Windows paths. A package living on a

UNC path such as `\\wsl.localhost\...` fails with `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` because pnpm
r
ewrites the leading `\\`. Packing to `.tgz` makes pnpm copy real files into the profile, which is th

e
most reliable route.
### 4. From source
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Editing `lib/index.js` (Host half) needs a reinstall or an app restart; `lib/client.js` (client half

)
reloads with the page.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

* **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) registers four same-origin routes on `ctx.webServer`:
`GET /health`

, `GET /inspect`, `POST /capture`, `POST /resolve`. Everything comes from existing
services; nothing

is written to disk and no schema changes. A request carrying a foreign `Origin`
gets `403 cross-ori

gin` before it can read a session.
* **Client half** (`lib/client.js`) mounts an invisible component

on `conversation.composer.dock` to
receive the current `sessionId` and the composer's `inputActions

`, then listens for copy and paste in
the document capture phase.
* Media never leaves memory as a U

RL: the clipboard itself carries the bytes, so pasting works across
sessions, across windows, and af

oard itself carries the bytes, so pasting works across
sessions, across windows, and after a reload.
## Requirements

* DSH Web UI 0.2.x (the desktop app uses the same UI and works identically).
* A secure context for
the clipboard APIs: `http://127.0.0.1` and `http://localhost` both qualify.
## Configuration
All optional, set on the plugin entry in `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Attachments that are skipped appear in the response's `warnings` and in the browser console; the res

t
of the message is still copied.
## Verified on this machine (2026-11-03, DSH `0.2.1-rc.5`)
| Check | Result |

| `GET /health` | `200 {"ok":true,"version":"0.2.0",...}` |
| `GET /inspect` | 200, shapes for 2 ses

sions and 10 / 267 user messages |
| `POST /capture` on a real 8-screenshot message | 8 PNGs, bytes

`bytes`**, `warnings: []` |
| Text of that payload | 859 characters, identical to the message body

|
| `POST /resolve` (by token) | text and all 8 attachments byte-identical |
| `POST /resolve` (text

fallback) | same text, 8 attachments |
| Cross-site request (forged `Origin`) | `403 {"ok":false,"e

rror":"cross-origin"}` |
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and security
* Bridge routes accept same-origin requests only. `/inspect` returns shapes only (session id, messag

e
seq, text length, block types) and never lifts message text out of a session.
* Captured bundles s

tay in Host memory (the most recent 32 by default) and vanish when the plugin
unloads or the Host re

starts. Nothing is written to disk.
* The clipboard is written only when you click copy; the plugin

never reads it and never uploads it
anywhere.
